tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active tab underline, links, success states. White (light) / color-primary-text (dark) on it: 5.0:1 / 5.9:1.

tokens.name: color-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of primary buttons; also the text colour on color-primary-soft (6.1:1 light, 6.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-primary-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on color-primary fills. Dark theme uses deep green text because the lighter accent fails with white.

tokens.name: color-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, selected evidence card, applied-suggestion highlight. Put color-primary-hover text on it, not color-primary.

tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the main content area.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Top bar, context panel, cards, editor canvas, dialogs.

tokens.name: color-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Icon rail, table headers, input wells, footer action bar. Body text only; color-text-muted here is 4.3:1 light — use it for 14px+ secondary text, never for essential labels.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: All body copy, headings and narrative text on color-bg, color-surface and color-surface-muted.

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, class names, helper text on color-surface and color-bg (4.6–4.8:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between regions, card outlines. Decorative only — not enough for control boundaries.

tokens.name: color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and textarea borders; checkbox outlines (3.3–3.5:1, meets non-text contrast).

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Save failed, validation errors, destructive buttons. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: color-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for error banners and the Save-failed label; color-danger text on it.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Needs teacher verification, Changes requested, Demo mode strip text.

tokens.name: color-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background for the Demo strip, verification flags and Changes-requested label; color-warning text on it (4.6:1 / 8.1:1).

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Approved status, Saved confirmation. Same hue as primary by design; always shown with a check icon.

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: In review status, source chips (evidence IDs).

tokens.name: color-info-soft
tokens.usage: Background for In-review label and source chips; color-info text on it (6.0:1 / 8.3:1).

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus-visible ring on every interactive element, offset 2px (5.2:1 / 6.9:1 on surface).

families.sans: "Inter Variable", Inter, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Noto Sans SC", "Source Han Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif
families.cjk: "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Noto Sans SC", "Source Han Sans SC", sans-serif

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, in PageHeader. Use 24px on tablet/mobile.

styles.name: label-strong
styles.usage: Student names in rows, field labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Observed counting objects to 20 during snack time.

styles.name: narrative
styles.sample: Aria shows growing confidence when retelling familiar stories.
styles.usage: AI narrative editor and report preview; line length 65–85 characters.

styles.name: secondary
styles.sample: K2 Sunflower · Last observed 3 days ago
styles.usage: Meta text, dense controls, table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Source IDs, timestamps. Never for interactive labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding, card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (comfortable).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page regions, desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page header and content.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar height.

tokens.name: icon-rail-width
tokens.usage: Persistent icon rail on desktop and tablet.

tokens.name: sidebar-panel-width
tokens.usage: Collapsible context navigation panel.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every control, in both densities.

tokens.name: mobile-tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height before safe-area inset.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max readable width of main content (report editor may go full width).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, status labels, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list rows, evidence cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs, drawers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Avatars, segmented tab track.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards. Prefer borders; shadow is a whisper.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Drawers, popovers, bottom sheets, dialogs.
